comparison_key: the record's own `hash` field = SHA1 of json.dumps([name,bytes,initial,final,cycles],separators=(",",":")) -- the whole record except `idx`, which is a position label. Four independent keys (hash / whole-record-incl-idx / initial / name+bytes+initial) all return the same 7,127.

provenance.note: tests/v30/v0.2's own provenance files, preserved verbatim (gzipped, mtime=0) before the suite was deleted.  emit_log.txt is the ONLY surviving record of v0.2's reroll history and is what the reroll-vs-different-draw classification was derived from; it exists nowhere else, in git or otherwise.

record_schema: identical to tests/v30/v0.2 -- name, bytes, initial, final, cycles, hash, idx. `idx` is the case's ORIGINAL v0.2 output index.
what: Every tests/v30/v0.2 case that tests/v30/v0.3's first-1,000-per-form PREFIX does not reproduce at the same index, preserved verbatim before v0.2 was deleted.
